behavior: TDLR TABS explicit data-center project descriptions now determine project asset_type from current accepted, evidence-bound records independently of an achieved lifecycle milestone. Ordinary process_records ingestion invokes the industry-only recompute after binding accepted or rejected changed source versions; unchanged replays preserve the established classification.

The primary TDLR project's exact source_id/external_id record is valid even with ingestion's null-candidate separate decision. A current project-specific unmatched/separate decision overrides this direct evidence; supplemental records still require current matched decisions.

Current source revisions and explicit latest project-match retractions remove stale industry support; conflicting supported asset types resolve to unknown and incompatible derived lifecycle projections are omitted while event history is retained.

The bounded existing-record recompute is gridlens.intelligence.lifecycle_service.refresh_project_asset_type(session, project) -> (before, after). It mutates only Project.asset_type and does not flush or commit; callers control transaction scope.

Default opportunity evidence and intelligence-card passages use concise readable excerpts. The canonical Evidence abstract and exact source quotes remain retained; exact research-claim quote validation uses the internal non-serialized source text.

Authenticated GET /api/evidence/{evidence_id}/content?offset=0&limit=4096 exposes retained evidence text only on request, in chunks of at most 4096 characters. The evidence panel loads successive chunks only after the user selects Load full source.
Data-center industry classification does not add lifecycle events, reported dates, MW values, tier changes, or qualification conclusions.

measurements.method: Synthetic representative payload with six repeated source passages, each 4016 characters including opaque base64 text; JSON encoded size compared before and after compact source assembly.
measurements.note: The measured fixture covers six evidence representations; the 43,853-byte live payload from the audit remains the pre-fix reference and was not queried again.

regression_coverage: Real process_records primary TDLR path: new accepted record, unchanged replay, explicit project-specific unmatch, accepted evidence revision, then rejected revision retracting asset classification; no lifecycle milestone, MW, date, or tier is inferred.
Exact source_id/external_id classification alongside ingestion's null-candidate separate decision; project-specific current unmatched decision retracts it.
Database-backed accepted evidence revision, explicit unmatch retraction, and conflicting lifecycle asset types without an UNKNOWN lifecycle-rank crash.
Asset-only recompute preserves Signal tier, unknown MW/start/duration, and empty lifecycle event/projection state.
Compact source excerpts drop opaque base64 payload while retaining an exact source claim quote and excluding internal raw text from serialization.
Authenticated evidence content route returns bounded offsets and rejects an offset past the retained text.
Browser evidence pane does not request full content until clicked and continues loading bounded chunks on demand.

checks.result: 3 passed in 2.52s; isolated completion_b_test, including actual process_records path

risks_and_limits: The project asset parser intentionally classifies only explicit data-center language from TDLR TABS; it does not infer asset type from lifecycle events, facility size, dates, MW, or qualification.
The raw-content route returns the retained Evidence.abstract text. It does not stream separate object-storage artifacts.
No broad backend suite, production query, provider call, migration, commit, push, PR action, or deployment was run.
